objective: Build a small Python package named ledger in this project. ledger/__init__.py must export a class Ledger with add(account: str, amount: int), balance() -> int (sum of all amounts), by_account() -> dict[str, int], save(path) writing JSON, and a classmethod load(path) that restores a saved ledger. Add ledger/cli.py so that `python3 -m ledger.cli demo` adds cash 5 and cash -2 to a new ledger and prints exactly `balance=3`. Add test_ledger.py at the project root that exercises all of the above and prints OK on success. Use only the standard library.

verify.run: python3 -c "from ledger import Ledger; l=Ledger(); l.add('cash',5); l.add('cash',-2); print(l.balance())"
python3 -c "from ledger import Ledger; l=Ledger(); l.add('a',5); l.add('b',7); l.add('a',1); d=l.by_account(); print(d['a'], d['b'])"
python3 -c "import os,tempfile; from ledger import Ledger; l=Ledger(); l.add('x',10); p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'l.json'); l.save(p); m=Ledger.load(p); print(m.balance())"
